name: Acherontic-Crucible
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, towering mountain ranges emerge like the bones of the planet.
The air carries burnt sugar and sulfur, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Debris from starship crash site (warship) rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
